itemized.notes: Peter Corroon, Mayor, Year-End Report January 31 for the 2004 cycle (form checks 'January 31 of each year'; signed 1/31/05, clerk stamp JAN 31 2005). Both county schedule forms are stubs with 'See Attached' handwritten across them; the itemization is the campaign's own typed PORTRAIT spreadsheet - Schedule A on PDF pages 4-5 and Schedule B on pages 7-8 (the sheets carry their own 'PAGE n OF 8' headers). PDF pages 9 and 10 are a Wells Fargo business-checking statement for 'CORROON FOR MAYOR' and are NOT schedule pages; nothing was transcribed from them. FOUR PROPERTIES TO RESPECT: (1) on SCHEDULE A the sheet prints a DATE ONCE at the head of a group and leaves the following rows' date cells EMPTY - there is no ditto mark, so 62 of the 72 contribution rows honestly carry no date and are flagged needs_review, with the most recent date printed above each one recorded in its note as context only; Schedule B by contrast dates every row. (2) The COMPLETE MAILING ADDRESS column is printed but empty on every contribution row (the filer entered no addresses - not a county redaction), so this filing carries NO donor geography. (3) Both schedules carry an IN KIND marker column to the right of the amount; the five in-kind contributions (54,989.13) and the six in-kind expenditures (54,989.13) mirror each other exactly and BOTH count toward the printed totals. (4) Several source spellings are kept verbatim: 'Russsell A. Kennedy' (three s), 'Advanced Communicarion', 'Inaugration party', 'Utah  AFL-CIO' (double space), 'Laurie A. Niederee MD'. Six Schedule B rows are dated in JANUARY 2004 at the end of an otherwise chronological 2004 list, for post-election volunteer/transition events that must be January 2005 - filer typos, retained verbatim and flagged in the row notes; one 12/28/04 payroll row also sits out of sequence among the 10/2x rows. Balance chain closes: line 3 56,250.81 + line 4 114,609.13 = line 5 170,859.94; 170,859.94 - 166,124.70 = 4,735.24 = line 7.
